title: Blackknife: Query-Free Black-Box Rewiring Attacks on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.29240v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs) perform well on graphs with multiple node and relation types, but their robustness to attacks with restricted structural access remains insufficiently understood. We propose Blackknife, a query-free, strict black-box evasion attack that observes only the one-hop structures of the attacked nodes, their ground-truth labels, and raw features within the permitted action space. No victim-model outputs are used to train the surrogate, generate perturbations, or select attacks.Blackknife trains a shared surrogate using only observable edges and relation types, then optimizes structural perturbations through continuous relaxation and projected gradient ascent. Each rewiring operation deletes one edge and adds another of the same relation type, preserving the target node's total degree and degree for each relation type. translated_title: Blackknife：针对异构图神经网络的免查询黑盒重连攻击
translated_abstract: 异构图神经网络（HGNNs）在包含多种节点类型和关系类型的图上表现优异，但其对结构访问受限攻击的鲁棒性仍缺乏充分研究。我们提出了Blackknife，一种免查询的严格黑盒规避攻击，它仅观测被攻击节点的一跳结构、其真实标签以及允许动作空间内的原始特征。该方法不使用任何受害者模型的输出来训练代理模型、生成扰动或选择攻击。Blackknife仅使用可观测的边和关系类型来训练一个共享代理模型，然后通过连续松弛和投影梯度上升来优化结构扰动。每次重连操作会删除一条边并添加另一条相同关系类型的边，从而保持目标节点的总度数以及每种关系类型下的度数不变。余弦相似度惩罚和自适应结构分类器进一步约束……
tldr: Blackknife提出了一种免查询的严格黑盒攻击方法，仅通过观测一跳结构和保持度数不变的边重连操作，即可有效规避异构图神经网络的防御。
en_tdlr: Blackknife is a query-free, strict black-box evasion attack on heterogeneous graph neural networks that relies only on observable one-hop structures and degree-preserving rewiring operations to optimize structural perturbations.
